queries.title: Search Queries (Domains, Brands or Advertiser IDs)
queries.description: Enter domain names (e.g. 'nike.com', 'shopify.com'), brand names, or Google Advertiser IDs (starting with 'AR...').

format.title: Ad Format
format.description: Filter ads by format: All, Images only, Text ads only, or Video ads only.

maxAdsPerQuery.title: Max Ads Per Query
maxAdsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of ad creatives to collect per search query.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of concurrent queries executed simultaneously.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select Apify datacenter or residential proxies for large volume scrapes.
